following.scope: Independent recorded 20ms boundary proxies, not recomputed native physics or classifier accuracy. evaluation_contract.scope: Independent recorded 20ms boundaries, not detector accuracy or physics recomputation. Motion windows retain actual native movement after commands, not instantaneous arrest. Settled, resumed and completed are separate; no observed true-slip opportunity is not a perfect score.

protocol.timing_boundary: Attempt wall includes asset verification, compilation, settling, authored planning/IK, physics, contact scoring and recorded state construction. protocol.comparison: Two shared XY layouts at each friction and mass; identical native mechanics and starting state within each scene. Baseline, acquisition probe-only and contact-history variants each have separately matched complete arm-tape/open-jaw controls, plus common hold. Probe-only and history share acquisition; only history adapts after qualification. All failures and full-duration aborts remain; invalid/incomplete tapes are never extended.
protocol.split_note: Synthetic declared confirmation does not prove unseen scenes or physical reliability. Controller/evaluation parameters and sources are frozen before any native attempt.

hardware.memory_scope: Process lifetime high-water RSS before inspection; not per-episode or minimum RAM.
